M-CAPSULE.NAME: Capsule routines
M-CAPSULE.purpose: Compile recurring read-only MyGRACE orchestration into typed capsules (SkillCache-style) with an allowlisted program registry, replay qualification, stateful run/continue with judgment hand-back and deopt to the source skill.

export-CAPSULE_PROGRAMS.PURPOSE: Read-only allowlist: status, lint, lint-changed, ci, next, impact, trace, packet, focus — argv templates only, no shell, no mutating commands.

export-validateCapsuleDefinition.PURPOSE: Strict schema + allowlist + binding dataflow validation; returns coded issues instead of throwing.

export-executeCapsulePrograms.PURPOSE: Replay/run engine: spawns allowlisted programs, persists state at judgments/deopts, returns bounded step output previews.

export-capsuleProgramArgv.PURPOSE: Expands one program template against --path root and explicit --module/--files bindings (never env).

export-capsuleCommand.PURPOSE: mygrace capsule list|show|validate|qualify|run|continue; execution gated by integrations.capsules.enabled and by a matching qualification hash.

CrossLink.relation: runCommandOutcome envelope/exit-code contract; findProjectRoot from M-COMMON
daily-check capsule composes status/lint/ci/next routines from the skills

contract.purpose: Make recurring MyGRACE routines explicit, replayable and cheaper to invoke — while never letting a capsule execute anything beyond the read-only MyGRACE CLI surface.

param.name: root
param.description: Project root that owns capsules/ and local .mygrace/capsules/ state.

param.name: capsule
param.description: schema_version 1: bindings, program steps, optional judgment steps, source_skill.

param.name: bindings
param.description: module/files values from explicit CLI flags only.

param.name: fixture
param.description: Replay target for `capsule qualify`; run executes on the project root.

param.name: execution
param.description: status waiting|completed|deopted, step records with bounded output previews, judgment/runId.

param.name: records
param.description: Per-capsule hash recorded in .mygrace/capsules/qualifications.json after a successful replay.

error.description: run/qualify refuses a capsule without a matching replay record (exit 1); --allow-unqualified is dev-only.
A program step failed; control returns to the capsule's source_skill (exit 1).
Capsule file changed between run and continue (exit 1).
Info finding + state file; resume with `capsule continue <run-id>` (exit 0).
Invalid name/format/bindings or execution disabled by config (exit 2).

notes.note-1: ADR-10 safety: programs are a fixed allowlist of read-only MyGRACE commands; no shell, no arguments from env, values only from explicit CLI flags; capsule files are validated before every run.
notes.note-2: Qualification is replay + hash: `qualify --fixture <project>` executes every program on the fixture and records the capsule sha256; editing the capsule invalidates the record and `run` refuses again.
notes.note-3: Local-only state: `.mygrace/capsules/qualifications.json` and `state/<run-id>.json` are gitignored; capsules/*.json are committed. Execution is disabled by default in generated configs (`integrations.capsules.enabled=false`); this repository enables it for dogfooding.
notes.note-4: Experimental (SkillCache-inspired): no token-savings claims. `mygrace capsule run` removes repeated orchestration steps and hands control back at judgments; a failed program deopts to the source skill instead of hiding errors.
